sections.template:
WHEREAS the Landlord is the absolute owner of the property described herein and is desirous of letting out the same to the Tenant, and the Tenant has agreed to take the said property on rent on the terms and conditions set forth herein.

NOW THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have set their hands on this Rent Agreement on the day and year first above written at {execution_place}.

filing_checklist: Print on stamp paper of appropriate value (varies by state)
Both parties to sign on all pages
Two witnesses required with full name, address, and signature
Attach passport-size photographs of Landlord and Tenant
Attach photocopy of Landlord's property ownership proof
Attach ID proof of both parties (Aadhaar/PAN)
For tenure > 11 months: compulsory registration at Sub-Registrar
Retain one executed copy with each party
Tenant to obtain NOC from housing society (if applicable)
